Subject: Intro request: AWS Direct Connect for inference traffic

Hi Soojin —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We’re planning a pilot to move high-volume inference traffic for our EMR triage feature off the public internet and onto a dedicated AWS Direct Connect link into our VPC. Our procurement team is also asking for an "AWS co-sell" intro so we can engage the AWS account team and validate credits/engagement models.

Can you connect us to the appropriate AWS partner/account contact and help coordinate a short kickoff with security/networking and a mutual action plan? High-level goals: reduce latency variability, validate private connectivity for HIPAA controls, and confirm any pricing/credit mechanics for pilot capacity.

We have a simple network diagram attached for context. Proposed window for kickoff: Aug 1–4 (PST) — mornings preferred.

Attachments: [Attachment: network-diagram.png (image/png)]

Thanks,
